posts.post_caption:
Building AI agents is exciting until you need to debug multi-step workflows, tool execution, and unexpected model decisions. RagaAI Catalyst is an open-source Python framework that brings complete observability, tracing, and evaluation to agentic AI systems.

Key features include:
- Agentic Tracing: Trace multi-agent interactions, tool usage, and LLM calls step-by-step
- Visual Analytics: Timeline and execution graph views for deep debugging
- Evaluation Framework: Compute metrics like faithfulness, hallucination, and context relevance
- Synthetic Data Generation: Generate test cases automatically from documents or CSVs
- Guardrails & Red-Teaming: Scan for safety vulnerabilities, harmful content, and bias

If you're building production AI applications, RagaAI Catalyst gives you full visibility into agent behavior. Check out raga-ai-hub/RagaAI-Catalyst on GitHub!
